title: Phase 1: Product Validation - Smoke test checkout flow and landing page
description:
Execute Phase 1 of revenue execution plan:

**Objective**: Confirm product readiness for paying users (15min)

**Tasks**:
1. Smoke test checkout flow (5min)
   - Test signup → onboarding → beat upload → checkout
   - Verify Stripe test mode works
   - Confirm license PDF generation

2. Landing page audit (5min)
   - Check value prop is clear: "0% commission beat marketplace"
   - Verify CTA works: "Start Selling Today"
   - Mobile responsiveness check

3. Identify blockers (5min)
   - Document any broken flows
   - Flag critical bugs

**Success Metric**: Green light to start outreach OR critical blocker list for immediate fix

**Parent Plan**: [BRO-92](/BRO/issues/BRO-92#document-plan)
